prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop", "Use quick shortcuts to talk, pin, or hide your companion anytime while working."]
1: []
2: ["Managing Your Desktop Companion", "Learn how to minimize, show, or dock your pet on your computer screen.", "Right-click the desktop pet or system tray icon anytime for instant controls."]
3: ["Pick Your Pet's First Desktop Toy", "Choose a starting toy that will appear next to your pet on your desktop.", "Starter Items"]
4: ["Select How You Want to Start", "Choose a preset or custom path to begin. You can switch modes or customize features anytime in settings."]
5: ["Already adopted a pet? Sign into your existing account to automatically restore all saved pets."]
6: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Window", "Creating your desktop companion overlay. Your pet will launch on your screen in a moment."]
7: ["Design Your Custom Desktop Pet", "Upload a photo to build a customized companion for your desktop."]
8: ["Tip: Click and drag your pet anywhere on your desktop screen to reposition it."]
9: ["Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "Bring interactive pets, custom routines, and fun directly to your desktop workspace."]
